firmware.releaseNotes: Owner-authorized forward test target for the fixed 3.3.39 receiver and original-signed App 1.0.87. This delivery only increments the firmware version; product behavior is unchanged from 3.3.39. Use it to verify the global verified-update prompt and Later action from a non-OTA page, immediate device-request handling after Android service recreation, and device-originated OTA with MCU-confirmed durable transfer progress and apply status. Install the fixed receiver first: a transfer performed by 3.3.38 cannot validate the new receiver UI. Preserve explicit fresh consent, no open recording, battery-or-charging admission, SD/LiveMap workspace exclusion, protocol, BLE identity, keys, layout and original Boot. Full/recovery candidate registration does not publish a channel or generate a delta. The owner selects channel publication and any exact-base delta; physical success still requires post-reboot target version, full raw image identity and matching confirmation.
